name: Malakout
overview: The series follows the profound spiritual journey of 'Haj Fattah Soltani', a wealthy and influential man who suffers a devastating car accident that leaves him in a state of brain death and a deep coma. During this critical period, his soul separates from his physical body to embark on a metaphysical purgatory journey. Accompanied by a divine messenger, Haj Fattah is forced to confront the true consequences of his earthly actions, review his past deeds, and desperately try to rectify his mistakes before it is too late and his time officially runs out.
